mapping.summary: Danish bank-connected payment journal with approvals and automatic bank reconciliation.
claims: Covers vendor, employee and customer payments and credit memos
Direct bank connection to send payments and receive statements and status updates
One journal for payments across bank accounts and foreign currencies
Fills and validates vendor bank details from the IBAN
Approve payment lines one by one or in batches, skipping approval below a limit
Bank account verification against payment fraud
Reconciles statements automatically on import, with user-defined matching rules
Combines several payments to the same payee into one transfer to cut fees
Tracks payment service provider transactions and fees and matches them to sales orders
Payment status shown per journal line, synced with the bank
Activation goes through a Dynamics partner
For Denmark, Faroe Islands and Greenland
Works with BC Essentials and Premium
